adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` runs an `else` branch when a destination lacks `credentialId`. That branch filters `this.calendarCredentials` by `c.type === destination.integration` and then calls `createEvent(c, event)` for *each* matching credential. Because this happens inside the `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop, multiple destinations without `credentialId` will repeat the same “create on all credentials of this integration” behavior, producing N(destinations w/o credentialId) × M(credentials of that type) external events. Previously, this “create on all credentials of integration” path ran once for a single `event.destinationCalendar?.integration`, not once per destination.
